data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's mechanism asserts that decentralized networks 'naturally avoid' a monoculture of assumptions via multiple independent design processes, but it supplies no causal mechanism forcing design diversity. The claim is asserted as default, then the countercondition that decentralized nodes share a common open-source foundation encoding the same assumptions is admitted. This means the proferred causal story (independent design processes) can be defeated by the very mechanism it criticizes (shared assumptions). The target never identifies the distinguishing evidence the problem demands for apparent independence vs shared-cause correlation, beyond listing it as an observation countercondition.
